def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def hollow_rects(grid):
    """Each color's cells as a bounding box, split into hollow-rectangle borders and scattered noise: (rects, noise_counts)."""
    from collections import Counter
    rects = []; noise = {}
    for col in set(v for r in grid for v in r) - {0}:
        cells = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(r) if v == col]
        rs = [i for i, j in cells]; cs = [j for i, j in cells]
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
        if len(cells) == 2*(r1-r0+1) + 2*(c1-c0+1) - 4 and r1 > r0+1 and c1 > c0+1:
            rects.append((r0, r1, c0, c1, col))
        else:
            noise[col] = len(cells)
    return rects, noise

def checkerboard_fill(grid, color_by_rect=None):
    """Keep each hollow rectangle's border, drop scattered cells, fill interiors with checkerboards of noise colors matched by count (half the interior area), starting at the top-left interior cell."""
    rects, noise = hollow_rects(grid)
    out = [[0]*len(grid[0]) for _ in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1, col in rects:
        for i in range(r0, r1+1): out[i][c0] = out[i][c1] = col
        for j in range(c0, c1+1): out[r0][j] = out[r1][j] = col
    noise_list = sorted(noise.items())
    used = set()
    for r0, r1, c0, c1, col in sorted(rects, key=lambda R: (R[1]-R[0])*(R[3]-R[2])):
        need = ((r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1))//2
        nc = next(k for k, n in noise_list if n == need and k not in used)
        used.add(nc)
        for i in range(r0+1, r1):
            for j in range(c0+1, c1):
                out[i][j] = nc if (i+j) % 2 == (r0+1+c0+1) % 2 else 0
    return out
'''
